response.rationale: Both answers express “just now/a short time ago.” Indonesian “barusan” is a colloquial adverb meaning recently, while Malaysian Malay “sebentar tadi” is an established expression for a short time ago. The different-common-word relation is useful as a preference contrast, not an exclusive-language claim. No false-friend issue is present.
